invariants.rationale: The static factory method instantiates and returns a new JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter, which should not be null.
The returned object is constructed as a JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter, so this must hold.
inflightInstantTimestamp is forwarded to the constructor and used directly; a null Option would be unusual and likely not allowed.
conf is required as a constructor argument and is likely not expected to be null.
writeConfig is needed to create the writer and is used as a constructor argument.
